hypothesis: Omitting a pathology covariate that rises with age and differs by cell type produces a spurious genotype x cell type x age interaction exceeding 1 SE of the interaction estimate, whereas including pathology removes this bias.
protocol: Simulate N=400 donors with ages top-coded at 90. Make pathology a binary covariate with prevalence increasing with age (logistic on age) and a cell-type-specific effect on usage, with no true three-way genetic interaction. Fit usage ~ G x C x A with and without pathology and PMI as covariates. Repeat 2000 times. Record mean three-way estimate, its SE, and the rejection rate at alpha 0.05 with and without adjustment.
success_criterion: Mean bias of the three-way estimate without pathology exceeds 1 SE in magnitude, and with pathology included it falls below 0.2 SE; otherwise the design does not need pathology adjustment for age-dependence claims.
